newsitem.title: USA: Health Outcomes still sees Q3, Q4 pickup.
newsitem.headline: Health Outcomes still sees Q3, Q4 pickup.

text.p: Health Outcomes Management Inc on Friday reaffirmed its outlook for better performance in the company's third and fourth quarters.
It reported a loss of $0.02 per share compared to a profit of $0.01 per share for the second quarter ended August 31.

"When we reported the first quarter's performance on July 22, we said that we expected a weak second quarter financial performance due to softness in several market segments with better performance in the third and fourth quarters," said president William Peter. "That is still the outlook."
Health Outcomes Management supplies computer software and services focused on improving patient health care.
